targets.query:
from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_live" and r._field == "successCount" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "HTTP success")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_live" and r._field == "errorCount" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "HTTP errors")
